halt_reason_summary: The test-runner agent aborted before invoking the suite. Its protocol requires a project-level .claude/settings.json to guarantee an autonomous run free of mid-suite permission prompts; that file does not exist in this repository. This is a harness-precondition failure, NOT a test failure: the suite itself is green. `npm test` was run directly by the orchestrator immediately after the abort and returned 3 files / 20 tests passing, and `npm run check` returned clean. The same green result was independently observed earlier by the implementer and again by the code-reviewer, each running the real command.
why_not_auto_resolved: Creating .claude/settings.json was explicitly forbidden by the operator for this session, and hard rule 1 of /relay-execute independently prohibits writing anything under .claude/. The test-runner's own recommendation to create that file therefore could not be followed. No file under .claude/ was created or modified.
stages_completed_for_phase_1: tdd test-first pair (APPROVED, RED verified dynamically)
manual_recovery_paths: Accept the phase as done on the strength of the direct verification above: the suite is green, code review APPROVED, and the D8 mutations already applied. The only unexecuted stage is the formal /relay-test + /relay-test-review wrapper.

If the formal stage is wanted, the operator — not an agent — must create .claude/settings.json with allow patterns for npm/vitest/wrangler, then re-run /relay-execute. It will pick up at phase 2, since phase 1's row is already complete.

The two acceptance criteria this phase serves (AC-1 share-creates-task, AC-5 empty-share-creates-nothing) each retain a browser-gesture half that no automated tier in this project can reach; those remain manual regardless of this halt.
fallback_reason: --no-worktree chosen by the operator: the repo's scripts/worktree-bootstrap.sh is the unedited relay template (npm ci and .dev.vars copy both commented out), so a worktree would have had no node_modules and no secrets, and HEAD did not yet carry the PRD/plan artifacts.
